evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says: 'This could take ten to fifteen minutes of your time, if that's okay?' — time-boxed, but no explicit promise of a dependable quote and no clear wait for yes before proceeding.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name: Kathy Gaynor. Moving day: October 7th or 8th (Wednesday). Route: 5827 Badge Creek Drive, Houston 77066 to 6618 Sutton Metals Drive, Houston 77086. Approximate size: 'under 2000' → later corrected to 2000 sq ft.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked AFTER probing started. Rep says: 'Kathy do you have any other concerns about the moving process?' — comes after pickup location has already been requested.
evidence_quotes.logistics_gathered: Property type (house), floor/stories (one story both ends), addresses. Missing: number of rooms, walking distance, additional rooms, special considerations, additional stops.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: Property verified at ~2000 sq ft (threshold). Rep correctly says: 'I have to transfer your call to a moving specialist so that can give you more accurate code' — appropriate routing to walkthrough specialist for a 1,800+ sq ft move. Call cleanly routed; no abandonment mid-pitch.

top_strength: Rep correctly identified the 2,000 sq ft threshold, verified it online when customer hesitated, and routed the call cleanly to a specialist for a virtual walkthrough rather than over-pricing on this intake call.
coaching_note: Ask 'What are your biggest concerns about this move?' **before** you start asking logistics details — you asked it after you'd already collected the pickup address.
